output_policy: Every VCF/JSON byte and complete BAM header/full-record-byte multiset, including duplicate multiplicity. Only BAM record order may differ.
timing_policy: Cache preparation, hashes, warmup, comparison and cleanup are excluded. Archive loading remains timed. No OS page-cache clearing. All application processes run serially on the same inherited CPU mask.

cpu_affinity.reason: No portable CPU pinning on this platform

environment.thread_scope: --threads is compute workers. Codec pools and coordinator roles are additional. A CPU mask limits eligible CPUs, not the number of threads.

publication_selection.reason: The original genotyped10k-fixed T8 configuration has an objective timing inconsistency in baseline formal round 2: process wall and application/UTC elapsed times disagree. Its entire original result file and all runs remain in evidence. Main tables use the original T1/T4 configurations and the complete independent T8 recheck (three formal pairs plus one warmup), rather than selecting individual favorable repetitions. No measurements are changed. Original T8 is excluded only from selected main statistics.
